PullRequest.Title: agentHost: Exclude SDK built-in skills
PullRequest.Body:
## Summary

- removes the explicit SDK platform-package built-in skill whitelist added in #336628
- stops passing `customize-cloud-agent` and `github-pr-media` through Copilot session `skillDirectories`
- excludes both `builtin/` and `builtin-skills/` from packaged SDK platform payloads
- keeps `enableSkills: true` so workspace and client/plugin skills continue to load
- updates Copilot prompt baselines to assert that runtime-owned built-ins are absent

## Validation

- Copilot prompt suite: 23 passing
- Copilot provider E2E suite: 196 passing, 18 expected pending
- affected Agent Host unit suites: 450 passing, 1 expected pending
- Copilot packaging tests: 23 passing
- client and build type-checks
- targeted ESLint
- full repository hygiene
- all 19 prompt baselines verified to omit `customize-cloud-agent`, `github-pr-media`, and `discover-resources`

Follow-up to #336628, which merged before this exclusion was requested.

(Written by Copilot)

Scenarios.Scenario: Cold Copilot client startup and managed-settings diagnostics resolve the packaged SDK/runtime before spawning or importing it.
Scenarios.CriticalPath: For a cold agent request, runtime-path resolution must finish before `RuntimeConnection.forStdio` can start the Copilot subprocess. Managed-settings diagnostics independently resolves and imports the SDK before its native/network query. Warm `_ensureClient` calls reuse the live client, and concurrent cold callers are coalesced by `_clientStarting`/`_ensureClientHealing`.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Tests for the runtime executable, native module, and SDK entry point in each candidate platform package.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Three concurrent existence checks for the preferred candidate; Linux can try one additional candidate only when the preferred package is absent. A coalesced cold client start performs this once, while an explicitly requested managed-settings diagnostic performs its own resolution.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: A valid candidate required sequential checks for runtime, native module, SDK entry point, and builtin-skills directory, followed by two SKILL.md checks; the diff reduces this to three parallel checks. A missing first candidate can perform up to two more failed stats than the old short-circuit, but this is bounded to three checks and only occurs for an absent preferred package.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: All checks for the selected candidate must complete before client startup or diagnostics can proceed.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One coalesced subprocess per live client lifecycle, with an existing bounded startup self-heal retry.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same runtime subprocess was started; this diff only removes builtin skill paths from path resolution/session configuration.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The subprocess must start before sessions can be created or resumed.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Queries native MDM and GitHub managed settings after importing the SDK.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One bounded diagnostic query per explicit diagnostics request.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same diagnostic query ran after a more expensive runtime-path validation.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Only blocks the requested diagnostics result, not ordinary session progress.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: The platform-candidate count is one on macOS/Windows and at most two on Linux; startup frequency is bounded by the coalesced client lifecycle rather than callers.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Three filesystem checks run in parallel per candidate. Client acquisition coalesces concurrent callers, and startup retry remains globally bounded.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: A live Copilot client is reused for warm calls; startup promises coalesce cold callers. Runtime-path checks have no separate cache, and diagnostics intentionally performs an independent check.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: changed file checks, candidate loop, startup caller, and coalescing fields are directly visible.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Filesystem stat latency varies by installation and remote environment, but the diff lowers valid-path operation count and bounds missing-candidate work.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The normal cold path drops three existence checks and removes sequential dependency; the only adverse edge is two extra parallel stats for an absent preferred package, which is bounded and not a realistic user-visible degradation.

Scenarios.Scenario: Creating or resuming a Copilot session discovers configured skills and assembles outbound model prompts.
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Session configuration is built before the SDK `createSession`/`resumeSession` IPC request. Model prompt assembly and the provider network request occur when the user sends a turn; skill metadata/tool schemas contribute to serialization and input-token processing.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: The SDK discovers skills from plugin directories and explicit non-file-backed skill directories.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Explicit skill directories are deduplicated by `toSdkResourceDirectories`; file-backed plugins are represented once through `pluginDirectories`. The diff removes exactly two SDK-package builtin skill directories while preserving workspace/client/plugin discovery.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Every create/resume supplied two additional builtin skill directories (`customize-cloud-agent` and `github-pr-media`) for SDK discovery.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Skill discovery contributes to session launch and prompt assembly before the session/model request can use those skills.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Sends one createSession or resumeSession configuration to the Copilot runtime.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One SDK session call per create/resume attempt; no per-skill IPC fan-out is introduced.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same single session call included two extra builtin skill paths.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The session call must complete before the session is usable.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Serializes assembled instructions and tool definitions into each provider request.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One provider payload per model turn. The changed snapshots show removal of the builtin-skills availability text and the skill tool schema when no remaining skill is available.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Requests advertised the two builtins and included a skill tool definition; the diff removes that metadata, reducing bytes and tokens.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Payload serialization, transfer, and provider input processing are on the model-response critical path.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Sends the assembled prompt/tool payload to the configured model provider.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One request per user/model turn, subject to the provider's existing protocol and prompt caching.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same provider request carried additional builtin-skill metadata and a skill tool schema.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The request is the dominant response-latency boundary.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Cost scales with session create/resume count and model turns; effective explicit skill cardinality is unique directory count after `toSdkResourceDirectories` deduplication, reduced by two in this diff.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Each session launch issues one SDK create/resume call. No loop or aggregate burst is added; existing sessions may operate independently.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No Agent Host cache is added or defeated. Static prompt prefixes may receive provider-side caching (Anthropic snapshots mark an ephemeral cache-control prefix), but the diff only removes metadata and does not worsen cold or warm behavior.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: converter code proves deduplication remains, launcher code proves two paths are removed, and provider snapshots prove smaller outbound prompts/tool lists.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Exact token savings and provider latency vary by model and cache behavior, but all changed mechanisms remove work rather than add it.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The feared loss of outer-Set deduplication is neutral because the converter already deduplicates directories; removing the two builtins reduces discovery, serialization, network bytes, and input tokens.

Scenarios.Scenario: Desktop and remote product packaging materializes the target Copilot SDK platform package.
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The packaging task ensures the target package is installed, globs its files, filters the stream, and writes the product artifact. This is build-time only and does not block end-user startup after installation.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Globs the selected platform package and copies included files into desktop or remote artifacts.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One selected SDK package per target build. Work scales with files and bytes under that package; the diff excludes all files under `builtin/` and `builtin-skills/`.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The selected package glob included both builtin directory trees.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: File enumeration/copying is on the packaging task's critical path, not product runtime.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Uses the existing npm-package ensure path for cross-target package availability.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: At most one ensure operation per desktop or remote target packaging invocation.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same ensure operation ran, then additionally validated two builtin SKILL.md files.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Package availability must be established before the file stream is created.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: The controlling input is file/byte count in one target SDK package, not the number of supported platforms; two directory trees are removed from the copied set.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Desktop and remote packaging each construct one gulp stream for the selected target package; no new per-file subprocess or unbounded parallelism is introduced.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Existing node_modules/package-manager state determines whether ensure work is warm; the diff does not change package keys or installation caching.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: both gulp callers and the exclusion glob construction are directly traced.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: The exact artifact-byte and build-time reduction depends on SDK package contents, but filtering cannot increase copied file cardinality.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The diff reduces filesystem enumeration/copy volume and packaged artifact size while preserving the required runtime, native module, and SDK entry point.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance pass over all 25 changed files and paginated patches. Traced cold startup/diagnostics, session create-resume and model prompt assembly, and desktop/remote packaging. No diff-introduced performance issue met the reporting threshold; all material changes remove filesystem checks, copied payload, skill discovery, prompt bytes, or input tokens, and existing deduplication/coalescing remains intact.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
